description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves WOLF TOTEMS (Saga of the Great Wolf, 1 CP, any phase) through the S panel — WP-S3 (ruling: used before the mortal wound — RULINGS.md § WP-S3). Fixture sw11e_s3_active (P1 Space Wolves ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. In the player's Shooting phase (Grey Hunters B carry a [HAZARDOUS] plasma pistol) a real click opens the S panel; a real click on WOLF TOTEMS' Use opens the friendly-unit picker (INFANTRY/MOUNTED only, no VEHICLE); a real click on Grey Hunters B spends 1 CP; the unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds (not against ordinary damage) for the phase — the engine rolls it for mortal wounds.
